proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: unramified permanence makes j unramified; the diagonal of a unramified morphism is an open immersion, and condition (2) makes Delta_j bijective on k-valued points, hence an isomorphism, hence j is a monomorphism; the equivalence-relation identities (reflexivity via e, symmetry via i, transitivity via c) then read off directly from the commutative diagrams of condition (3), giving an equivalence relation on U(T) for every T over S (source lines 443-454)
